scripts.secret:stripe:webhook: wrangler pages secret put STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET --project-name ironpulse-gym
scripts.secret:whatsapp: wrangler pages secret put WHATSAPP_CLOUD_TOKEN --project-name ironpulse-gym
